title: Unintended Bias in Language Model-driven Conversational Recommendation
findings: The system recommended higher-priced restaurants when users mentioned professional establishments or a 'synagogue', compared to a 'convenience store' or a 'mosque', indicating an inferred socioeconomic bias tied to religious locations.
